get.description: This will return simple counters, for a given website ID, for visits over the last N minutes

parameters.name: lastMinutes
parameters.description: Number of minutes to look back at (between 1 and 2880)

parameters.name: showColumns
parameters.description: The columns to show / not to request. Eg 'visits', 'actions', ...

parameters.name: hideColumns
parameters.description: The columns to hide / not to request. Eg 'visits', 'actions', ...

get.description: Returns the last visits tracked in the specified website You can define any number of filters: none, one, many or all parameters can be defined

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Period to restrict to when looking at the logs

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: (optional) Number of visits rows to return

parameters.name: countVisitorsToFetch

tags.name: Live
tags.description: The Live! API lets you access complete visit level information about your visitors. Combined with the power of Segmentation, you will be able to request visits filtered by any criteria. The method "getLastVisitsDetails" will return extensive RAW data for each visit, which includes: server time, visitId, visitorId, visitorType (new or returning), number of pages, list of all pages (and events, file downloaded and outlinks clicked), custom variables names and values set to this visit, number of goal conversions (and list of all Goal conversions for this visit, with time of conversion, revenue, URL, etc.), but also other attributes such as: days since last visit, days since first visit, country, continent, visitor IP, provider, referrer used (referrer name, keyword if it was a search engine, full URL), campaign name and keyword, operating system, browser, type of screen, resolution, supported browser plugins (flash, java, silverlight, pdf, etc.), various dates & times format to make it easier for API users... and more! With the parameter '&segment=' you can filter the returned visits by any criteria (visitor IP, visitor ID, country, keyword used, time of day, etc.). The method "getCounters" is used to return a simple counter: visits, number of actions, number of converted visits, in the last N minutes. See also the documentation about Real time widget and visitor level reports in Matomo. You may also be interested in steps to export your RAW data to a data warehouse.
